answer: AI agents routing marble freight through an export harbor resist Sybil attacks using proof-of-burn protocols. Each new agent must provably destroy scarce tokens by sending them to an unspendable address, generating an on-chain receipt. An attacker incurs the verifiable, irreversible loss of liquid capital per identity, exposing costless agent swarms as an economic fable. A primary limitation is that wealthy adversaries can exploit market downturns to cheaply burn tokens and amass identities.
